aspects.says: A transaction belongs to the business day given by the network's cutover in the network's zone, with daylight saving time, the cutover moment counted as the network writes it, weekends and network holidays rolled forward, and the host's DE 15 kept when it sends one.
basis: section:19.2. A Transaction Belongs to the Business Day That the Network's Cutover Gives It

aspects.says: Clearing records travel in network-defined files, and on a single-message link the online messages are the records the network settles from.
basis: section:19.1. A Clearing Record Carries the Final Amount and the Approval It Completes
aspects.reason: file schedules and layouts belong to each network and are described, not computed; nothing deterministic to grade beyond the quiz's question on the record's contents

aspects.says: The receiver of an 0500 compares every totals field with its own count and answers 2 when any differs, even when the nets agree; DE 97 is a C or D sign and 16 digits.
basis: section:19.4. The Receiver Compares Every Total, Because Equal Nets Can Hide Different Counts

aspects.says: A day's totals count only that day's approved requests and acknowledged reversals, keep authorizations out of the money fields, and count each reversal once, in fields of its own, without taking its original off.
basis: section:19.3. Both Ends Count the Day by the Same Rules, and a Reversal Is Counted in Fields of Its Own

aspects.says: A message delivered after the cutover counts on the day of its own DE 15 at both ends, not on its original's day.
basis: section:19.2. A Transaction Belongs to the Business Day That the Network's Cutover Gives It

aspects.says: A chargeback is a new record that quotes the ARN and moves money in the clearing and settlement of the day it arrives.
basis: section:19.5. Matching Puts Every Record in One Category, and Each Category Has an Owner

aspects.says: Matching on the terminal with the RRN puts every clearing record and every approval in exactly one category: matched, amount differs, duplicate presentment, not authorized or not presented.
basis: section:19.5. Matching Puts Every Record in One Category, and Each Category Has an Owner

aspects.says: A clearing record carries the final amount and the approval code that ties it to its authorization; without the code the issuer posts the sale and keeps the hold.
basis: section:19.1. A Clearing Record Carries the Final Amount and the Approval It Completes

aspects.says: An 0510 moves no money and corrects no totals; a 2 starts the search for the transactions, and an unanswered 0500 is simply sent again.
basis: section:19.4. The Receiver Compares Every Total, Because Equal Nets Can Hide Different Counts
